name: Capturin' The Booty
source:
You are Gustav, a former merchant who has decided to become a pirate. Life is great, for the most part, but it can get annoying especially if you have to spend your time on the same ship with Nadar, one of the most aggravating pirates out there. But when a horrible incident goes wrong, Gustav has to work with Nadar and realize that he's not so bad and that he has his own issues to work through. Will their bonds become stronger or will their differences stop them from being happy?

[From [url=https://chellaytiger.itch.io/capturin-the-booty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是古斯塔夫，一位决定转行当海盗的前商人。大多数时候，生活都很美好，不过也会有烦心事，尤其是不得不与纳达尔这种最惹人恼火的海盗之一待在同一条船上时。然而，一场可怕的意外迫使古斯塔夫与纳达尔合作，也让他意识到，对方并没有那么糟糕，而且有自己的问题需要面对。两人的羁绊会愈发深厚，还是彼此的差异会阻止他们获得幸福？

[摘自[url=https://chellaytiger.itch.io/capturin-the-booty]itch.io[/url]]
